name: seomatic
description: SEO agent for your own site: real Google Search Console answers, site audits, AI visibility and citations, keyword and backlink research, and staged fixes you approve before they go live in WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix and more. Bundles the SEOmatic skills and the hosted SEOmatic MCP server (OAuth).

seomatic.description: Hosted SEOmatic MCP server (streamable HTTP). Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to SEOmatic on first use; no key or local install needed.
